title: DevOps Metrics
content:
This page is internal. Click here to get to the IPEX DevOps Metrics landing page.

Research show that there are five key indicators of how well we do software delivery and​ operational performance.

To start the following metrics should be collected.

  • Deployment frequency 

  • Lead time for changes

Metrics storage

Metrics will be stored in CBF / IPEX data lake in Azure. In the data lake the data is stored in Apache Parquet format.

Raw data will be stored in DevOps team Azure subscription.

……

Metrics visualisation and analyse

Collected metrics will be visualised on a easy to access dashboard. It will be possible to compare metrics for different teams. Visualisation can be used as inspiration for teams to improve or start collecting metrics.

To analyse the data and prepare it for visualisation, Databricks and Jupyter notebooks will be used.

Data will be shared with Insights team to be able to do correlation between, e.g. PEP Score and Deployment frequency.
